name: @harness/desktop
description: Electron desktop client for the Harness LLM agent runtime

scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=require('path');const src='src/renderer';const dst='dist/renderer';for(const f of fs.readdirSync(src)){if(/\.(html|css)$/.test(f)){fs.cpSync(p.join(src,f),p.join(dst,f))}}"
